image_description: A large whale is captured mid-action, breaching or slapping its tail against the ocean surface. The whale has a dark, mottled grey body with visible white patches (likely barnacles) on its underside and flukes. The tail flukes are raised high out of the water, creating significant splash. The background is open blue ocean under a clear sky.
